Cookies & browser storage

What PolyGolf saves on your device.

Last updated: October 4, 2026.

Essential game storage

PolyGolf uses local storage and session storage to keep guest progress, settings, sign-in sessions, saved maps, viewed notifications and room state working. These are browser storage technologies, even though they are not all cookies. Storage is specific to your browser and website domain: littlelinks.study and polygolf.lol have separate local saves and sessions.

What stays on your device

Guest progress, appearance and control settings remain until you clear the site’s data. Account sign-in tokens are stored so you can stay signed in between visits; sign out on shared computers. Room state uses session storage. Course and item previews may be cached to avoid repeated downloads and rendering. Account progress is also saved on our backend, so clearing local storage does not delete your account.

Analytics, advertising and payments

The current game does not include advertising cookies, cross-site advertising trackers or an optional marketing analytics SDK. Real-money purchases are unavailable, so the game does not store payment-card details. Hosting and authentication providers may use essential security mechanisms and technical logs. We will update this page and request consent where required before adding optional tracking.

External services

Supabase provides account and game data services; Netlify hosts the site. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts. Social links open Instagram, X, YouTube or Discord only when selected; those services use their own policies. A community reward records that you opened a link, not whether you followed an account or joined a server.

Your controls

Use Settings to change game preferences and Account to sign out. Your browser’s site-data settings can remove or block stored data. Clearing data removes guest progress and may sign you out; blocking essential storage can stop saves or sign-in from working. To delete a cloud account, contact support rather than only clearing browser data.

Contact

For questions or privacy requests, contact PolyGolf Staff at room310support@gmail.com. See our privacy policy for account data and your rights.
